title.narrative: ACA/2017/394-496 Cambodia Programme for Sustainable and Inclusive Growth in the Fisheries Sector: Aquaculture Component (CaPFish Aquaculture)

description.narrative: The programme aims at supporting the development and scaling up of successful pro-poor aquaculture systems, as well as the development and dissemination of more sustainable and efficient practices in the rapidly growing commercial sector, through a systemic and comprehensive approach to support the aquaculture sector, fully aligned to the National Aquaculture Development Strategy and the updated Sector Planning framework for Fisheries
